full_judgment: 4. The said application was opposed by the plaintiff and the matter was heard on 24-4-67. The plaintiff pleaded that the time for referring the matter to Arbitration by the defendant is already barred by limitation and that although long period has elapsed, the defendants have failed to satisfy the claim of the plaintiff after the survey of the damaged wheat even after the final claim was made on 18-4-66. The plaintiff further asserted that there is no agreement in existence between the parties and as such there is nothing to refer to Arbitration. The plaintiff also asserted that to delay the suit the defendants have chosen to file an application by way of staying the proceeding of the suit.
